premises.text: Sending money abroad is plagued by loss, delay, high fees, and opacity
premises.evidence_span: We've experienced every problem imaginable as it relates to sending money

premises.text: SendMe is a payroll-integrated global flex-pay app for cross-border sends, phone top-ups, and bill pay
premises.evidence_span: SendMe is a global flex pay solution that integrates with an employer's payroll system

premises.text: Fee of about $1 (and up to $4 plus 2% FX) undercuts industry averages
premises.evidence_span: We charge between $1 and $4 up front and 2% in foreign exchange

premises.text: Wallet balances are held FDIC-insured at a financial institution
premises.evidence_span: that balance is held at a financial institution and is FDIC-insured

premises.text: Central Bank of Mexico connection enables instant Mexican bank transfers; BBVA ATM network adds cash-out
premises.evidence_span: We can also send funds to a network of over 10,000 BBVA ATMs in Mexico

premises.text: Payroll-plus-MSB category reduces regulatory and CAC costs while shifting payer to employers
premises.evidence_span: shift user behavior, reduce regulatory costs, and reduce customer acquisition costs

premises.text: Products are distributed via banks, payroll providers, and employers
premises.evidence_span: We distribute the products to banks, payroll providers, and direct to employers

value.text: Employees get high-transparency, lower-cost cross-border payroll transfers
value.evidence_span: a solution that is high transparency, lower cost

secondary_value.text: Recipients keep more of remitted funds as transfer costs fall
secondary_value.evidence_span: With each 1% reduction in the cost of international transfers, $6 billion goes into the hands of recipients
